topics.title: Formal essay structure (论说文)
topics.description: Openings, transitions, conclusions — the conventions of academic Chinese argument

guide.intro: 议论文 (yìlùnwén) — the argumentative essay — is the dominant academic genre in Chinese high schools, university entrance exams, and editorial pages. It has its own conventions: sourced openings, signposted transitions, weighty conclusions. C2 essay writing means writing inside this scaffold rather than translating English structure into Chinese words.

sections.text: The opening (开篇 kāipiān)

A 议论文 typically opens with one of three moves: a quoted line of classical or canonical authority (借古立论), an observation of a current phenomenon (现象切入), or a counter-position that the writer will then refute (破题). All three are register-marked — the colloquial "let me tell you about a friend of mine…" opener that works in English would feel out of place.

rows.source: 古人云："读万卷书，行万里路." 此言至今仍有 深意。
rows.pinyin: Gǔrén yún: dú wàn juàn shū, xíng wàn lǐ lù. Cǐ yán zhì jīn réng yǒu shēnyì.
rows.translation: The ancients said: "Read ten thousand books, walk ten thousand li." These words still carry deep meaning today.

rows.source: 近年来，人工智能 之 发展 日新月异。
rows.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, réngōng zhìnéng zhī fāzhǎn rìxīnyuèyì.
rows.translation: In recent years, the development of AI has changed by the day. (Phenomenon opener.)

sections.text: Transitions (过渡 guòdù)

Chinese academic writing signals its structure overtly. Each new paragraph typically begins with a connector that names its function: 首先 (first), 其次 (next), 再者 (furthermore), 此外 (besides this), 然而 (however), 反观 (looking conversely at), 综上所述 (summing up the above). Skip these and the essay reads as choppy, no matter how strong each paragraph is on its own.

rows: 首先 / 其次 / 再者
From this we can see — drawing inference
In sum / from all the above — pre-conclusion marker

sections.text: The body argument

Each body paragraph typically follows a 论点-论据-论证 structure: state a thesis-claim (论点), give evidence (论据), explain the reasoning (论证). The evidence is often a citation of a 名人 ("famous figure"), a historical episode, or a contemporary statistic. Hedges like 据统计, 研究表明, 不可否认 and 必须承认 mark the move from claim to evidence.

rows.source: 据统计，超过 七成 的 受访者 表示 …
rows.pinyin: Jù tǒngjì, chāoguò qī chéng de shòufǎngzhě biǎoshì…
rows.translation: Statistics show that over 70 percent of respondents say…

rows.source: 不可否认，问题 之 复杂 远 超 预期。
rows.pinyin: Bù kě fǒurèn, wèntí zhī fùzá yuǎn chāo yùqī.
rows.translation: It cannot be denied that the problem is far more complex than expected.

sections.text: The conclusion (结尾 jiéwěi)

The conclusion is rarely a meek English-style "in conclusion, …". A strong 议论文 ending circles back to the opening (照应开头), restates the thesis with elevated weight, and often closes with a four-character flourish or a forward-looking call. The phrases 综上所述, 由此可见, 总而言之 cue the reader to expect the wrap-up.

rows.source: 综上所述，唯有 持之以恒，方 能 致远。
rows.pinyin: Zōng shàng suǒ shù, wéi yǒu chí zhī yǐ héng, fāng néng zhì yuǎn.
rows.translation: In sum: only with perseverance can one reach far. ("方能" is the elevated form of 才能.)

sections.text: Convention #1 of academic Chinese: prefer the 4-character cadence in your closing line. 持之以恒, 方能致远, 任重道远, 砥砺前行 — these are not clichés, they are tonal closers that signal the essay is ending with weight.

lessons.title: Openings of the academic essay
lessons.description: 古人云, 现象切入, and the 破题 move

exercises.prompt: An essay opens with "古人云：\"读万卷书，行万里路.\"" This is which type of opening?
exercises.answer: Quoted-authority opener (借古立论)
exercises.explanation: 古人云 / 古语有云 / 子曰 — all are signals that the writer is opening with a citation of canonical authority before staking their own thesis.

exercises.prompt: the opening type to its function
Build a phenomenon-opener: "In recent years, the development of AI has changed by the day."
exercises.answer: 近年来 人工智能 之 发展 日新月异

exercises.prompt: An essay opens "有人 认为 教育 应当 以 应试 为 重 ， 然而 …". This is which opening type?
options: Refutation (破题) — set up the opposing view to demolish
exercises.answer: Refutation (破题) — set up the opposing view to demolish
exercises.explanation: 有人认为…然而… is the classic 破题 frame — name the position you'll refute, then pivot. Beloved by 议论文 writers.

exercises.prompt: Build a quoted-authority opener: "Confucius said: 'Learning without thinking leads to confusion.' These words still hold today."
exercises.answer: 子 曰 学 而 不 思 则 罔 此 言 至今 仍 不 过时

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads an opening line in essay register. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 古人云读万卷书行万里路，此言至今仍有深意
options: 古人云读万卷书行万里路，此言至今仍有深意
古人说要多读书多走路，到现在还是有道理
据说古代的人喜欢读书旅行，今天看来也不错
我觉得读书和旅行都很重要
exercises.answer: 古人云读万卷书行万里路，此言至今仍有深意
exercises.explanation: 古人云 + classical 4-4 quotation + 此言 + 至今仍 — full essay-register stack. The distractors paraphrase in conversational, semi-formal, or first-person registers.

exercises.prompt: An essay opens with "___ 云 ， '己所不欲 ， 勿施于人.'" Fill the canonical attribution-frame (2 characters).
exercises.answer: 古人
exercises.explanation: 古人云 / 古语有云 — both are formulaic openers attributing a saying to canonical antiquity. Standard 议论文 move.

exercises.prompt: the opening template to the rhetorical move it announces
Which opener would feel WRONG in a serious 议论文?
options: 古人云："读万卷书，行万里路."
近年来，人工智能之发展日新月异。
上次我跟我朋友吃饭的时候，他说了一句话让我印象深刻。
有人认为传统教育已不合时宜，然而事实未必如此。
exercises.answer: 上次我跟我朋友吃饭的时候，他说了一句话让我印象深刻。
exercises.explanation: Personal anecdote with first-person framing is fine for English essays but reads as out-of-register in Chinese 议论文. The other three are textbook openers.

exercises.prompt: Build a refutation-opener: "Some hold that wealth is the only measure of success; this view, however, is far from comprehensive."
exercises.answer: 有人 认为 财富 是 衡量 成功 的 唯一 标准 此 观点 然而 远 不 全面

lessons.title: Transitions and signposting
lessons.description: 首先 / 其次 / 再者 / 反观 — making structure visible

exercises.prompt: the transition to its function
Halfway through an essay, a paragraph begins with "反观西方教育体系…". The writer is signaling:
options: A summary of what was just said
A pivot to a contrasting case used as comparison
exercises.answer: A pivot to a contrasting case used as comparison
exercises.explanation: 反观 = "by contrast / looking conversely at." A standard structural move in 议论文 — pivot to the comparison case to sharpen the thesis.

exercises.prompt: The pre-conclusion marker that means "summing up the above" is ___ (4 characters).
exercises.answer: 综上所述
acceptableAnswers: 综上所述 (zōng shàng suǒ shù)
exercises.explanation: 综上所述 cues the reader: the wrap-up paragraph is starting. A near-mandatory move in formal Chinese essays.

exercises.prompt: An essay paragraph begins "不仅如此 ， 此 现象 在 农村 地区 尤为 明显." The 不仅如此 signals:
options: A new topic unrelated to the previous
exercises.answer: Escalation — "not only this, but moreover"
exercises.explanation: 不仅如此 = "not only this" — a paragraph-level escalation that adds weight to the prior point. Standard essay rhythm.

exercises.prompt: Build a transition-rich sentence: "From this we can see that education reform must consider both efficiency and fairness."
exercises.answer: 由此 可见 教育 改革 必须 兼顾 效率 与 公平

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions of a transition sentence. Pick the most essay-formal one.
exercises.spokenText: 综上所述，唯有兼顾效率与公平，方能行稳致远
options: 综上所述，唯有兼顾效率与公平，方能行稳致远
总的来说，只有同时考虑效率和公平，才能走得远
总而言之，效率和公平都要兼顾，才能走得稳
我觉得，效率和公平都重要，这样才能长久
exercises.answer: 综上所述，唯有兼顾效率与公平，方能行稳致远
exercises.explanation: 综上所述 (formal pre-conclusion) + 唯有 (literary "only") + 方能 (literary 才能) + 4-character closer 行稳致远. Full essay register. The distractors are progressively more colloquial.

exercises.prompt: each paragraph-opening transition to its position in an essay
An essay pivots: "反观 ___ 教育 体系，注重 学生 的 自主 探索." Fill the standard contrastive territory (2 characters; opposite of 中国).
exercises.answer: 西方
exercises.explanation: 反观西方教育体系… is the canonical pivot in Chinese essays comparing systems. 反观 + the contrastive case is a structural workhorse.

exercises.prompt: An essay reads: "由此可见，问题之复杂远超预期." The 由此可见 signals:
options: A summary of evidence drawing an inference
exercises.answer: A summary of evidence drawing an inference
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 = "from this we can see" — the writer is drawing a conclusion from preceding evidence. The phrase is a pivot from data to claim.

exercises.prompt: Build a multi-transition sentence: "First, we must observe the phenomenon; next, we must analyze its causes; finally, we must propose a solution."
exercises.answer: 首先 我们 应当 观察 现象 其次 分析 成因 最后 提出 对策

lessons.title: Evidence and argument hedges
lessons.description: 据统计 / 研究表明 / 不可否认 / 必须承认

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its move in the argument
An essay paragraph reads: "不可否认，问题之复杂远超预期。然而…". The 不可否认…然而… pair functions as:
options: Concession then pivot — "granted X, but Y"
A direct contradiction with no resolution
exercises.answer: Concession then pivot — "granted X, but Y"
exercises.explanation: 不可否认 lets you grant the opposing view's strongest point; 然而 then pivots to your counter-argument. Standard rhetorical move in formal argument.

exercises.prompt: Build: "Statistics show that over 70 percent of respondents are dissatisfied with this policy."
exercises.answer: 据统计 超过 七成 的 受访者 对 此 政策 不 满意

exercises.prompt: Which hedge would you use to introduce a peer-reviewed academic finding?
exercises.answer: 研究表明
exercises.explanation: 研究表明 = "research shows / studies indicate" — the formal citation hedge for scholarly findings. 据统计 cites numbers; 听说 / 好像 are conversational and out of register.

exercises.prompt: Build a long concession-pivot sentence: "It must be admitted that the new technology brings convenience; nevertheless, the privacy risks cannot be ignored."
exercises.answer: 必须 承认 新 技术 带来 便利 然而 隐私 风险 不 容 忽视

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a citation-hedged claim. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 研究表明，长期睡眠不足将显著提高心血管疾病的风险
options: 研究表明，长期睡眠不足将显著提高心血管疾病的风险
听说睡得少不好，对心脏不太好
据说睡眠不足会让人得心血管病
exercises.answer: 研究表明，长期睡眠不足将显著提高心血管疾病的风险
exercises.explanation: 研究表明 + 显著提高 + 心血管疾病 — academic-register stack with quantified verb and technical noun phrase. The distractors are colloquial.

exercises.prompt: the hedge to what it actually concedes

pairs.right: Conceding the opposing view's strongest point
Acknowledging an unavoidable counter — "one must admit"

exercises.prompt: An essay sets up a concession: "___ 否认，问题 之 复杂 远 超 预期 ， 然而 …". Fill the literary 3-character hedge.
exercises.answer: 不可
exercises.explanation: 不可否认 = "it cannot be denied" — the formal concession that lets you grant the strongest opposing point before pivoting with 然而.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence shows the cleanest 论点-论据-论证 (claim-evidence-reasoning) structure?
options: 教育 是 好 东西 — 我 觉得
教育 改变 人生 ， 据 统计 ， 受 高等教育 者 收入 平均 高 出 三 成 ， 因此 政策 应 予 支持
我 喜欢 学习 ， 我 同学 也 喜欢
学习 重要 — 大家 都 知道
exercises.answer: 教育 改变 人生 ， 据 统计 ， 受 高等教育 者 收入 平均 高 出 三 成 ， 因此 政策 应 予 支持
exercises.explanation: Three moves: 论点 (claim — education changes lives), 论据 (evidence — statistics on income), 论证 (reasoning — therefore support the policy). The other options stop at claim or assertion only.

exercises.prompt: Build an evidence-led claim: "Research indicates that overuse of social media in adolescents is significantly correlated with anxiety levels."
exercises.answer: 研究 表明 青少年 过度 使用 社交 媒体 与 焦虑 水平 显著 相关

lessons.title: Conclusions with weight
lessons.description: 综上所述, 4-character closers, and 方能 elevation

exercises.prompt: "唯有持之以恒，方能致远." The word 方能 here is the elevated form of:
exercises.answer: 才能
exercises.explanation: 方能 (fāng néng) is the literary register of 才能 — "only then can." Standard in formal essay closers.

exercises.prompt: the 4-character closer to its sense

pairs.right: The burden is heavy and the road long

exercises.prompt: Build a weighty conclusion: "In sum, only with perseverance can one reach far."
exercises.answer: 综上所述 唯有 持之以恒 方能 致远

exercises.prompt: Why do Chinese academic essays often close with a 4-character idiom?
options: It is a tonal convention — the cadence signals the essay is ending with weight
exercises.answer: It is a tonal convention — the cadence signals the essay is ending with weight
exercises.explanation: Convention, not decoration. A C2-fluent essay rounds out with 4-character cadence the same way an English essay might land on a parallel triplet.

exercises.prompt: Build a weighty multi-clause closer: "In sum, the road ahead is long and the burden heavy; only by forging ahead together can we reach far."
exercises.answer: 综上所述 任重 而 道远 唯有 砥砺 前行 方能 致远

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions of an essay closer. Pick the one with the proper essay-register weight.
exercises.spokenText: 综上所述，唯有持之以恒，方能致远
options: 综上所述，唯有持之以恒，方能致远
总的来说，只有坚持下去才能走得远
总而言之，要坚持不懈，才能成功
我觉得只要坚持就一定能成功
exercises.answer: 综上所述，唯有持之以恒，方能致远
exercises.explanation: 综上所述 + 唯有 + 4-character idiom 持之以恒 + 方能致远 — quadruple essay-register stack. The distractors progressively descend toward conversational register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the closer: "___ 可见 ， 教育 改革 任重道远 ， ___ 砥砺 前行 ， 方能 行稳致远." Fill the inference marker (2 characters) and the precondition marker (2 characters).
exercises.answer: 由此 唯有
exercises.explanation: 由此 ("from this") + 可见 forms the inference move; 唯有 ("only by") + 4-character verb phrase forms the precondition for the 4-character payoff. Standard essay closer skeleton.

exercises.prompt: Which 4-character closer best fits an essay arguing that reform must be sustained over decades?
exercises.answer: 持之以恒
exercises.explanation: 持之以恒 = "persevere over the long run" — the canonical closer for any essay arguing for sustained effort. The other three idioms describe silence, gratitude, and reversed fortune respectively.

exercises.prompt: the 4-character closer to the kind of essay it would seal

pairs.right: Essay calling for grit through hardship

exercises.prompt: Build an inference-pre-conclusion bridge: "From the above analysis, we can see that only when system, education, and culture work together can we move forward steadily and reach far."
exercises.answer: 由此 可见 唯有 制度 教育 与 文化 三者 协同 方能 行稳致远

lessons.title: Dialogue: Graduate writing workshop
lessons.description: Edit a peer's essay opening; defend or revise stylistic choices.

exercises.prompt: Peer essay workshop — tightening the prose

turns.speaker: chen
turns.text: 我的开篇是：「在当今全球化的浪潮中，我们不可不正视…」(wǒ de kāi piān shì zài dāng jīn quán qiú huà de làng cháo zhōng, wǒ men bù kě bù zhèng shì.)
turns.spokenText: 我的开篇是：「在当今全球化的浪潮中，我们不可不正视…」

turns.prompt: Polite peer feedback on a clichéd opener.
options: 开头略显套话，可否换个具体场景切入？(kāi tóu lüè xiǎn tào huà, kě fǒu huàn gè jù tǐ chǎng jǐng qiē rù?)

turns.answer: 开头略显套话，可否换个具体场景切入？(kāi tóu lüè xiǎn tào huà, kě fǒu huàn gè jù tǐ chǎng jǐng qiē rù?)

options: 总而言之，此题之深，犹待后人探赜。(zǒng ér yán zhī, cǐ tí zhī shēn, yóu dài hòu rén tàn zé.)

topics.title: C2 review — register, idiom, classical, rhythm
topics.description: Mixed-register paragraph parsing, idiom-in-context, register identification, and parallel rewriting

guide.intro: C2 mastery is not knowing one register — it's switching between them in a paragraph and recognizing the switch when someone else does it. This review pulls together classical particles, 成语 in modern context, register identification, and the rhythm of parallel construction.

sections.text: What this review tests

Four lessons, each targeting one C2-level skill: (1) parsing paragraphs that mix classical particles with modern register; (2) identifying which 成语 fits a real headline / news context out of multiple plausible candidates; (3) reading a paragraph and naming its register (official, independent press, satire, literary, academic); (4) recognizing imbalanced parallel constructions and rewriting them so the rhythm holds.
If a question feels like it has two right answers, it usually does — at C2 the test is often "which is more idiomatic / more in-register," not "which is grammatical."

lessons.title: Mixed-register paragraph parsing
lessons.description: Classical particles in modern prose — read, then identify the function

exercises.prompt: A 财新 editorial reads: "众所周知，此次改革之于国民经济，影响深远。然而，其执行之难，前所未有。" Which classical particle is doing the most structural work?
options: 之 — modifier-linker (here connecting nouns into formal phrases)
exercises.answer: 之 — modifier-linker (here connecting nouns into formal phrases)
exercises.explanation: 之于 (relation to), 改革之… (this reform's…), 其执行之难 (the difficulty of its execution). Three uses of 之 carry the editorial register.

exercises.prompt: each phrase from the editorial above to its function

pairs.left: 此次改革之于国民经济
pairs.right: 之于 — X's relation to Y

exercises.prompt: A government report uses "是以本部门决定…". The 是以 is functioning as:
exercises.answer: A formal "therefore" (= 因此)

exercises.prompt: Build a mixed-register sentence: "The reasons are three; this we cannot ignore."
exercises.answer: 其 原因 有 三 此 不可 忽视

exercises.prompt: An editorial writes "此 乃 国 之 大 事 也." The sentence-final 也 functions as:
exercises.answer: Classical assertion / copula marker
exercises.explanation: Sentence-final classical 也 was an assertion-marker in literary Chinese (≈ "… is the case"). Here it pairs with 此乃 + 之 to mark elevated register. The modern "also" 也 occupies a totally different syntactic slot.

exercises.prompt: Build a long mixed-register editorial sentence: "The development of artificial intelligence is the great trend of our time; it cannot be reversed, nor should it be feared."
exercises.answer: 人工智能 之 发展 乃 时代 之 大势 不可 逆转 亦 不必 畏惧

exercises.prompt: A reporter reads a mixed-register editorial line. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 众所周知，此次改革之于国民经济，其影响之深远，前所未有
options: 众所周知，此次改革之于国民经济，其影响之深远，前所未有
大家都知道，这次改革对国民经济的影响很深远，史上没有过
据说，这次改革对经济影响很大，是头一回
我们清楚，此次改革对经济影响深远，从未发生过
exercises.answer: 众所周知，此次改革之于国民经济，其影响之深远，前所未有
exercises.explanation: All four classical particles stacked: 众所周知 (所), 之于, 其, 之, 前所未有 (所). The other options paraphrase in modern colloquial or near-formal registers.

exercises.prompt: each classical particle to the modern function it performs in formal writing

pairs.right: Possessive / anaphoric (formal 它的 / 他的)
Coordinative / adversative connector (formal 并 / 但)

exercises.prompt: An editorial reads: "___ 周知，此次政策之于民生，其影响 ___ 深远." Fill the all-knowing 所-construction (3 characters) and the modifier-link (1 character).
exercises.answer: 众所 之
exercises.explanation: 众所周知 + 之于 + 其影响 + 之深远 — five classical particles in a single editorial sentence. The cluster is what marks 财新-style register.

exercises.prompt: In a modern editorial "其原因有三，此不可忽视", the 此 is functioning as:
options: A formal demonstrative pronoun (= 这 in elevated register)
exercises.answer: A formal demonstrative pronoun (= 这 in elevated register)
exercises.explanation: 此 is the literary counterpart of 这 — "this." Compare 此言 (this saying), 此事 (this matter), 由此可见 (from this we can see). It carries an editorial weight 这 doesn't.

lessons.title: 成语 in real context
lessons.description: Ten idioms, ten near-real headlines — pick the right fit

exercises.prompt: Headline: "创业三年终见曙光，张某 ___ 拿下千万融资." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 一鸣惊人
exercises.explanation: After years of obscurity the founder astonishes everyone — exactly the 一鸣惊人 frame.

exercises.prompt: Editorial: "此次援助仅占缺口的百分之一，对灾区而言无异于 ___." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 杯水车薪
exercises.explanation: 1% of need = a cup of water on a burning cartload. The textbook "hopelessly insufficient" idiom.

exercises.prompt: Op-ed on a fallen executive: "___, 终遭法律严惩." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 见利忘义
exercises.explanation: 见利忘义 = saw profit and forgot principle — the standard accusation aimed at corrupt executives.

exercises.prompt: Tech CEO at alma mater donation ceremony: "我之所以今日能站在这里，无非是 ___." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 饮水思源
exercises.explanation: 饮水思源 = drinking water, remembering its source. The conventional humble phrase for an alumnus giving back.

exercises.prompt: Friend missed a flight that later had a maintenance scare. You text: "哎，___, 看来反而是好事." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 塞翁失马
exercises.explanation: 塞翁失马，焉知非福 — bad luck that turns out to be good. The exact use case.

exercises.prompt: Arts column on a soprano's debut: "全场 ___, 落针可闻." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 鸦雀无声
exercises.explanation: 鸦雀无声 — total hush in a crowd. "You could hear a pin drop" — the literal English idiom 落针可闻 confirms it.

exercises.prompt: Profile of a war journalist: "她以 ___ 之 精神，深入战地三年." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 舍生取义
exercises.explanation: 舍生取义 = give up life to grasp righteousness. The idiom for risking life for principle.

exercises.prompt: Tech analysis: "这一规模的市场扩张，___, 史无前例." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 前所未有
exercises.explanation: 前所未有 — unprecedented. Pairs naturally with 史无前例 (unparalleled in history).

exercises.prompt: Award speech: "这位科学家 ___, 在国际上享有盛誉." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 名副其实
exercises.explanation: 名副其实 — name matches reality, the reputation is earned. The standard praise idiom.

exercises.prompt: Consolation to a friend whose deal collapsed: "___ 吧，缘分到了自然就好." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 顺其自然
exercises.explanation: 顺其自然 — let nature take its course. The Daoist-flavored consolation phrase.

lessons.title: Which register is this?
lessons.description: Read the paragraph, name the register

exercises.prompt: "我方对此表示强烈不满，并已就此向有关方面提出严正交涉." Register?
exercises.answer: Official diplomatic / state-media register
exercises.explanation: 我方 + 表示强烈不满 + 有关方面 + 严正交涉 — four official-register markers in one sentence.

exercises.prompt: "据知情人士透露，截至发稿，公司方面尚无正式回应." Register?
exercises.answer: Independent / commercial press hedging
exercises.explanation: 据知情人士透露 + 截至发稿 + 尚无回应 — the WSJ-style hedge cluster characteristic of 财新 / BBC中文 / 端传媒.

exercises.prompt: "这波操作我给满分，懂的都懂，233333." Register?
exercises.answer: Online satire / 微博 sarcasm
exercises.explanation: 这波操作 (sarcastic praise of a misstep) + 懂的都懂 (winking at censored topic) + 233333 (laughter). All three are unmistakable internet-satire markers.

exercises.prompt: "古人云读万卷书，行万里路。此言至今犹存深意。综上所述，唯有兼修，方能致远." Register?
exercises.answer: Formal essay / 议论文
exercises.explanation: 古人云 opener + 综上所述 pre-conclusion + 方能致远 4-character closer. All three are 议论文 conventions.

exercises.prompt: "空山不见人，但闻人语响. 返景入深林，复照青苔上." Register?
options: Tang-poetry literary register (王维 in fact)
exercises.answer: Tang-poetry literary register (王维 in fact)
exercises.explanation: Five-character per line, classical particles, painterly imagery — Tang poetic register. (This is 王维's 鹿柴.)

exercises.prompt: "研究表明，长期使用社交媒体与青少年焦虑水平显著相关." Register?
exercises.answer: Academic / scholarly register
exercises.explanation: 研究表明 (citation hedge) + 显著相关 (statistical-correlation jargon) + 社交媒体与焦虑水平 (technical noun phrase). Three academic-register markers in one sentence.

exercises.prompt: "咱这事儿吧，说大不大说小不小，先放放看呗." Register?
exercises.answer: Northern colloquial / Beijing-dialect-flavored everyday speech
exercises.explanation: 咱 (northern "we"), 事儿 (er-suffix), 说大不大说小不小 (colloquial reduplication), 放放看呗 (final particle 呗). Four colloquial markers — unmistakably casual northern speech.

exercises.prompt: "既然你已经决定了，那就放手去做吧。无论结果如何，我都支持你." Register?
exercises.answer: Conversational-formal — earnest but not literary
exercises.explanation: 既然 + 那就 + 无论…如何… + 我都 — formal connectors, but the rhythm is conversational and the second-person address is direct. Sits between casual and literary.

exercises.prompt: "是以本院驳回原告之诉讼请求." Register?
exercises.answer: Legal / judicial register (court opinion)
exercises.explanation: 是以 (formal 因此), 本院 (this court), 驳回 (legal verb "dismiss"), 之 (formal modifier-linker), 诉讼请求 (legal NP "plaint request"). Five judicial-register markers.

exercises.prompt: A reporter reads four sentences in different registers. Pick the one in independent / commercial-press hedge register.
exercises.spokenText: 据知情人士透露，截至发稿，公司方面尚无正式回应
options: 据知情人士透露，截至发稿，公司方面尚无正式回应
我方对此表示强烈不满
这波操作我给满分，懂的都懂
古人云：读万卷书，行万里路
exercises.answer: 据知情人士透露，截至发稿，公司方面尚无正式回应
exercises.explanation: 据知情人士透露 + 截至发稿 + 尚无正式回应 — three commercial-press hedge markers (anonymous source, time-fence, unanswered-status). Distinct from official protest, online satire, and essay-quoted-authority registers.

lessons.title: Rhythm — fix the imbalanced parallel
lessons.description: Identify which clause breaks parallel weight, and rebuild it balanced

exercises.prompt: Which sentence keeps the cleanest parallel rhythm?
options: 一方面要兼顾效率，另一方面要保障公平。
一方面要努力地兼顾整体效率，另一方面要保障公平。
一方面要兼顾效率，另一方面要切实地保障好社会公平。
一方面要兼顾效率问题，另一方面要保障公平。
exercises.answer: 一方面要兼顾效率，另一方面要保障公平。
exercises.explanation: Both clauses are exactly 要 + 2-char verb + 2-char object. The other three pad one side and break the rhythm.

exercises.prompt: Which is the imbalanced clause in this pair: "成功也好，失败这种事情其实也罢."
options: The first clause is too long
The second clause is padded — "这种事情其实" breaks the parallel with "成功"
exercises.answer: The second clause is padded — "这种事情其实" breaks the parallel with "成功"
exercises.explanation: 也好 / 也罢 demands matched short clauses. "成功 也好，失败 也罢" — two characters each side. Anything more is padding.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite the imbalanced sentence into balanced parallel form: "Believe it or not, the facts are right there."
exercises.answer: 你 信 也好 不信 也罢 事实 就 在 那里

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions of the same idea. Pick the one with the most balanced rhythm.
exercises.spokenText: 与其抱怨，不如行动
options: 与其在那里抱怨，不如赶紧采取一些行动
与其抱怨，不如积极地采取一些有效的行动
与其去抱怨这件事情，不如行动
exercises.answer: 与其抱怨，不如行动
exercises.explanation: Two characters versus two characters. The padded versions all break the cadence — that's the C2 rhythm test.

exercises.prompt: Which of these parallel constructions is most balanced?
options: 效率 优先 ， 公平 为 本
效率 是 我们 应该 优先 考虑 的 ， 公平 为 本
效率 优先 ， 公平 也是 一个 非常 重要 的 价值
我们 要 重视 效率 ， 同时 也 要 兼顾 公平
exercises.answer: 效率 优先 ， 公平 为 本
exercises.explanation: Two 4-character clauses with parallel grammar (NP + V/role). The other three pad one or both sides and break the cadence.

exercises.prompt: Build a balanced parallel pair: "Education roots the individual; education shapes the country."
exercises.answer: 教育 立 人 教育 兴 国

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions. Pick the one in balanced classical-flavored cadence.
exercises.spokenText: 与其坐而论道，不如起而行之
options: 与其坐而论道，不如起而行之
与其坐着空谈各种道理，不如起来去采取行动
与其讨论，不如赶快行动起来
与其在那里讨论道理，不如行动
exercises.answer: 与其坐而论道，不如起而行之
exercises.explanation: Two 4-character clauses, mirrored grammar (verb 而 verb-object). Classical-flavored 与其…不如… cadence at its most polished.

exercises.prompt: An editor flags this sentence as imbalanced: "我们应当倾听民意，回应民忧." The most likely fix is:
options: Match the first clause's structure: "我们应当倾听民意，我们应当回应民忧" (or both with 一方面 / 另一方面 framing)
exercises.answer: Match the first clause's structure: "我们应当倾听民意，我们应当回应民忧" (or both with 一方面 / 另一方面 framing)
exercises.explanation: Original: 我们应当倾听民意，回应民忧 — second clause drops 我们应当, breaking the parallel weight. The fix is to mirror the first clause's framing or use a parallel-pair connector. (Note: in some essay contexts the dropped second-clause subject is acceptable; the editor's call is style.)

exercises.prompt: Imbalanced: "成功也好，失败这种事情其实也罢，过程才重要." Fix the second clause to match: "成功 也好 ， ___ 也罢 ， 过程 才 重要." Fill with 2 characters.
exercises.answer: 失败
exercises.explanation: 也好…也罢 demands matched two-character clauses. The original's "失败这种事情其实" is padding. The clean form is 成功也好，失败也罢.

exercises.prompt: Literary editor reviewing a novelist's draft

turns.speaker: su
turns.text: 稿子整体我读完了，文气贯通，但有几处可商榷。(gǎo zi zhěng tǐ wǒ dú wán le, wén qì guàn tōng, dàn yǒu jǐ chù kě shāng què.)
turns.spokenText: 稿子整体我读完了，文气贯通，但有几处可商榷。

turns.speaker: su
turns.text: 第二章开头用了排比和反问，气势是有，但稍嫌雕琢。(dì èr zhāng kāi tóu yòng le pái bǐ hé fǎn wèn, qì shì shì yǒu, dàn shāo xián diāo zhuó.)
turns.spokenText: 第二章开头用了排比和反问，气势是有，但稍嫌雕琢。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: The most diplomatic, register-appropriate author reply.
options: 您所言极是，我再斟酌字句，化雕琢为自然。(nín suǒ yán jí shì, wǒ zài zhēn zhuó zì jù, huà diāo zhuó wéi zì rán.)
随便你怎么改。(suí biàn nǐ zěn me gǎi.)
你不懂我的风格。(nǐ bù dǒng wǒ de fēng gé.)
我才不改。(wǒ cái bù gǎi.)
turns.answer: 您所言极是，我再斟酌字句，化雕琢为自然。(nín suǒ yán jí shì, wǒ zài zhēn zhuó zì jù, huà diāo zhuó wéi zì rán.)

turns.speaker: su
turns.text: 好态度。第五章人物对话夹了不少香港用语，台湾读者恐生疏。(hǎo tài du. dì wǔ zhāng rén wù duì huà jiā le bù shǎo xiāng gǎng yòng yǔ, tái wān dú zhě kǒng shēng shū.)
turns.spokenText: 好态度。第五章人物对话夹了不少香港用语，台湾读者恐生疏。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Pick the chengyu that best praises a manuscript as "polished and refined."
options: 字斟句酌 (zì zhēn jù zhuó – weighing every character)
粗制滥造 (cū zhì làn zào – shoddy production)
信口开河 (xìn kǒu kāi hé – speaking carelessly)
不知所云 (bù zhī suǒ yún – making no sense)
turns.answer: 字斟句酌 (zì zhēn jù zhuó – weighing every character)

turns.speaker: su
turns.text: 字斟句酌——正是我对您的期待。(zì zhēn jù zhuó — zhèng shì wǒ duì nín de qī dài.)
turns.spokenText: 字斟句酌——正是我对您的期待。

turns.prompt: Finish the closing chengyu — "to put the finishing touch": 画___点睛.

turns.speaker: su
turns.text: 画龙点睛——再改一稿便可付梓。(huà lóng diǎn jīng — zài gǎi yī gǎo biàn kě fù zǐ.)
turns.spokenText: 画龙点睛——再改一稿便可付梓。
